steps.title: Hand Hygiene
steps.instruction: Perform hand hygiene with soap and water or alcohol-based rub for at least 20 seconds.

steps.title: Clamp Line
steps.instruction: Clamp all lumens before removal to prevent air embolism. Confirm all infusions are discontinued.

steps.title: Remove Catheter
steps.instruction: Don sterile gloves. Remove dressing. Withdraw catheter smoothly in one continuous motion while patient exhales or performs Valsalva.

steps.title: Apply Pressure
steps.instruction: Apply firm direct pressure to the site for a minimum of 2 minutes or until bleeding stops.

steps.title: Dress Site
steps.instruction: Apply sterile occlusive dressing to the site. Instruct patient to remain flat for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Line Removed Confirmation
steps.instruction: Inspect removed catheter to confirm it is intact. Measure and document catheter length. Send tip for culture if infection suspected.

steps.title: Procedure Complete
steps.instruction: Document removal date, time, catheter condition, and clinician. Monitor site for 24 hours for signs of complications.
